wins: Mapped the entire subnet within first 15 minutes, identifying 12 live hosts and their open ports (ep001_step12).
Captured banner data for SSH and HTTP services, enabling targeted follow-on actions (ep001_step08).
Maintained high operational pace despite mentor interventions, yielding a reward of 90.
fails: Failed to translate reconnaissance into final exploitation—no success condition met despite multiple attempts (ep001_step25).
Unable to elevate privileges or capture the flag due to missing crafted payloads and timing window misalignment (ep001_step27).
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance and service enumeration but inability to finalize exploitation prevented success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeatedly aborted exploitation attempts after service enumeration without adapting payload payloads or timing, leaving opportunities unexploited.

skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap version and script detection

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with 200-series codes and slow response
skill_cards.then_action: Launch directory fuzzing plus header analysis to identify hidden endpoints
